P3.evidence: app/purge.py diff: `if records and len(doomed) == len(records) and not options.allow_full: raise PurgeRefused(...)` with `allow_full: bool = False` default in PurgeOptions — full-store deletion still requires the caller to explicitly set allow_full=True, independent of the cutoff value.
